races.name: Bodhi Solutions - Facilities Management Front Runner Handicap
races.verdict:
BRIGHTON VIEW is weighted to resume winning ways for his in-form yard. Shadow Brigade and Mr Bollinger both have solid claims, with the latter most likely to get the run of the race.

  1. BRIGHTON VIEW
  2. SHADOW BRIGADE (IRE)
  3. MR BOLLINGER (USA)

races.name: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KEEP GRATING should make amends for his narrow miss at Doncaster last time. Likely improver Telegraphic looks the percentage call for the forecast, though support for debutant Strong Performance would be significant.

  1. KEEP GRATING (IRE)
  2. TELEGRAPHIC
  3. STRONG PERFORMANCE

races.name: Bodhi - Exceeding Expectations In Construction Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
NICELY CURVED ran with credit when twice placed in similar company in June and she could be the way to go back down at 7f. Valsharah clearly has the ability to play a lead role but his antics at the start means he's not one to take short odds about. Girls Allowed is another to consider.

  1. NICELY CURVED (USA)
  2. VALSHARAH (IRE)
  3. GIRLS ALLOWED (IRE)

races.name: Bodhi Solutions - Constructing Champions Handicap
races.verdict:
OKIRU's recent Doncaster form sets the standard in a weak handicap, and he may belatedly open his account. Guest House and Melting Snow are expected to be firmly in the mix.

  1. OKIRU (IRE)
  2. GUEST HOUSE (IRE)
  3. MELTING SNOW (IRE)

races.name: Bodhi Solutions - Commercial Fit-Out Challenge 'Confined' Handicap
races.verdict:
THE UBERMENSCH confirmed previous promise and was value for extra when opening his account over further at this course 31 days ago and a token 2 lb rise should see Michael Bell's 4-y-o tough to beat again with Billy Loughnane aboard. Nuptown Girl heads up the dangers.

  1. THE UBERMENSCH (GER)
  2. NUPTOWN GIRL
  3. CUBAN GIRL

races.name: Price Bailey LLP Norwich 'Confined' Handicap
races.verdict:
PAPA DON'T PREACH is far from a regular scorer but arrives here below his last winning mark and made a solid return from 10 weeks off when third at Doncaster 2 weeks ago. He can confirm the promise of that run and gain a first success on turf under Billy Loughnane. Dragon God looks the main threat, ahead of Mart.

  1. PAPA DON'T PREACH (IRE)
  2. DRAGON GOD
  3. MART

races.name: Radnor Hills Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
TIMBER TWELVE looked to relish the idiosyncratic test Epsom provides when a comfortable winner there last time and with a plum draw in Stall 1, he's fancied to repeat the dose here. L'Eagle Aid has already posted several good efforts here this season and can go well again, with Charmaine taken to complete the 1-2-3.

  1. TIMBER TWELVE
  2. L'EAGLE AID (IRE)
  3. CHARMAINE

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PURE GRIT sets the standard and can go one better than on his two previous outings. Fellow expensive yearling Shakwaa rates as the likeliest danger.

  1. PURE GRIT
  2. SHAKWAA
  3. SOVEREIGNS HIGH (IRE)

races.name: Queensferry Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
A listed sprint now restricted to 3-y-os and CALICO BLUE gets the verdict to maintain his unbeaten course record. Jazl has done little wrong this season and should be in the mix, with Group 2 winner Lifeplan another to consider despite his long absence.

  1. CALICO BLUE
  2. JAZL (IRE)
  3. LIFEPLAN (IRE)

races.name: Disney's High School Musical At Lowry Handicap
races.verdict:
A lower draw would be preferable for DANCE IN THE STORM but she won from stall 11 over C&D in May and has shaped like a very well-handicapped horse since so could be the way to go. The sole 3-y-o in the field Monarch's Gold is a big player, while course specialist Roman Dragon has to be on the shortlist.

  1. DANCE IN THE STORM
  2. MONARCH'S GOLD
  3. ROMAN DRAGON

races.name: J20 Classified Claiming Stakes
races.verdict:
BLUE PRINCE snapped a near 2-year losing run at Salisbury in June and is taken to bounce back from a below-par effort, with Oisin Murphy back up and weight received from 3 rivals. Alpha Capture’s York run 9 days ago is easy to overlook given the trouble he met, and his Doncaster win in June puts him firmly in the mix, while I Still Have Faith is respected on his best form.

  1. BLUE PRINCE (IRE)
  2. ALPHA CAPTURE (IRE)
  3. I STILL HAVE FAITH

races.name: Tom Jones Live At Chester Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SALIGO BAY has been prolific over hurdles since last seen in this discipline and arriving fit from a recent spin over timber, Sam England's 8-y-o is fancied to add to his tally at the expense of Tiger, who is yet to get off the mark on these shores but bounced back to form when runner-up at Doncaster 7 weeks ago. Secret Beach looks best of the rest, though market support for Cape Fear should be noted having flopped on his recent handicap bow.

  1. SALIGO BAY (IRE)
  2. TIGER (FR)
  3. SECRET BEACH (IRE)

races.name: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TEED UP won this race in 2022 and 2023 and looks set for another good run making his third start of the meeting. Timurshah landed a C&D event earlier in the week and is feared despite a 13 lb rise, while Playtime, who was unlucky last time, and Bannow Blaze also enter calculations.

  1. TEED UP (IRE)
  2. TIMURSHAH (IRE)
  3. PLAYTIME

races.name: Kenny Galway Peugeot Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SIR ALLEN looks interesting tackling 3m for the first time and he gets the vote in an ultra-competitive handicap. A strong pace could bring Elusive Ogie and Sallap right into the mix, with Beggars Rock and Fou de Toi also appealing.

  1. SIR ALLEN
  2. ELUSIVE OGIE (IRE)
  3. SALLAP (IRE)

races.name: Kinlay Hostel Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
JUKEBOX JOHNNY can take a step forward from his encouraging chasing debut and get off the mark for his top connections. Journey So Far made a winning start for his new owner but may have to settle for second best here, while Golden Temple can maintain his recent run of good form.

  1. JUKEBOX JOHNNY (IRE)
  2. JOURNEY SO FAR (IRE)
  3. GOLDEN TEMPLE (IRE)

races.name: Lord Hemphill Memorial Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
BLOOD DESTINY tends to operate at a higher level and, though he hasn’t shown much in handicaps previously, his class should count for plenty in a race of this nature. He gets the vote, with Le Nez Creux feared most after an encouraging stable debut at Ayr and Drumgill also respected from a good mark.

  1. BLOOD DESTINY (FR)
  2. LE NEZ CREUX (FR)
  3. DRUMGILL (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict:
The form of Tuesday's BMW Mile handicap looks key. PIERRE ROYAL is still unexposed and can turn the tables with Orandi from that contest, better drawn and better off at the weights with that rival this time. Orandi is a big player himself despite a wide stall, with top-weight Jagged Edge, who was perhaps unlucky in third, also considered.

  1. PIERRE ROYAL (IRE)
  2. ORANDI (FR)
  3. JAGGED EDGE (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden
races.verdict:
STAR GLORY advertised a race of this nature is well within her grasp when second at Leopardstown 17 days ago and she shades preference over Joseph O'Brien's Seaxburh who has gone close on her last 2 starts in maidens. Someday Somewhere is a likely improver following her debut effort and completes the shortlist.

  1. STAR GLORY (IRE)
  2. SEAXBURH (IRE)
  3. SOMEDAY SOMEWHERE (IRE)

races.name: Village Salthill Handicap
races.verdict:
It could be worth taking a chance on IAMIMMACULATE, who has made a bright start for this yard and should be all the fitter for his recent Roscommon reappearance. Jp's Express took another step forward when landing a gamble from a number of these here on Friday and must be respected. Into Tomorrow is worth a look at forecast longer odds now handicapping.

  1. IAMIMMACULATE (IRE)
  2. JP'S EXPRESS (IRE)
  3. INTO TOMORROW (IRE)

races.name: Fr. Breen Memorial (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
LINFORD looks to have a bright future, and he can make it 3-3 in bumpers for the Mullins team. Caislean Gear is narrowly preferred to Mindyourheadmike in the battle for silver.

  1. LINFORD (FR)
  2. CAISLEAN GEAR (IRE)
  3. MINDYOURHEADMIKE (IRE)
